description: Selected official legacy-login witnesses. Selector 12 receives protocol 13; this does not establish host or browser-mod compatibility.

source.access: Full recordings, endpoint and collector snapshots are local-only and outside Git.

archives.outcome: Stopped after unexpected stock-format challenge; no reply/login sent.
Joined using observed 27-byte challenge reply and synthetic selector-12 login; eight-second gameplay window.

source.selection: Both request/challenge exchanges; session 2 reply/login, first setup prefix through body spacing (25 command bytes, excluding server number), first pong and first 3/G motion/body frames. Other player appearances and identifiers in setup extensions are excluded.

reference.challengeSolver: src/client/challenge.rs at fbefe17 (restricted two-literal parser; no JavaScript execution)
reference.setupVersion: Direct command byte 23; independently checked by protocol-19 decoder rejection in tests/client_protocol.rs.

challenge.description: Elapsed-ms header, 6 command and encoded two-literal 27-character source; unexpected by initial 24-character parser.
Elapsed-ms header, 6 command and encoded two-literal 27-character source.

reply.description: Scripted reply computed with existing documented 27-byte transform; accepted by server.

login.description: Synthetic login generated from documented legacy layout; transmitted to official server.

setup.selection: First 25 command bytes only; original elapsed header and all setup bytes from server-number offset 25 onward omitted.

gameplay.description: First elapsed-framed p command; no protocol-13 semantic decoding.
First elapsed-framed 3 command; no protocol-13 semantic decoding.
First elapsed-framed G command; no protocol-13 semantic decoding.

limitations: One official-listed endpoint, two sequential reserved sessions; the first failed before login. No optional request variants were tested.
No third-party mod code was used by the scripted collector. This is not a capture of the real mod joining an official server.
The captured challenge conflicts with the real mod parser observed locally. No invented 24-character host profile is justified.
Protocol 13 is deliberately unsupported; selected motion/body bytes are retained as witnesses, not decoded using protocol-19 assumptions.
The setup prefix is a byte selection, not a full captured frame. Existing protocol-19 captures retain their original version and bytes.
